name: Regent Taipei
positioning: City hotel in Taipei's Zhongshan District, with eight restaurants, a heated rooftop pool and the Regent Galleria luxury shopping center an elevator ride from the lobby
best_for: Shoppers who want luxury boutiques inside the hotel building
Food lovers who want several restaurants under one roof
Travelers who want a Metro-connected base in Zhongshan District

facts.text: The hotel is in Taipei's Zhongshan District.
The hotel's address is No. 3, Lane 39, Section 2, Zhongshan North Road, Taipei.
The hotel is within walking distance of the Zhongshan Taipei Metro (MRT) station.
Rooms have marble bathrooms with deep soaking tubs.
Rooms have oversized pillows and pressure-relieving mattresses.
The dining options include classic Cantonese cuisine, French-inspired teppanyaki and charcoal-grilled prime beef.
Azie serves a fusion of Asian and Western cuisine.
Treatments are offered at the Wellspring Spa.
Yoga is offered at the hotel's Health Club.
The hotel has 24,000 sq. ft. of function space.
Several luxury brands, including Chanel, Hermes, Bvlgari and Louis Vuitton, established their first Taiwan location at Regent Galleria.

highlights.text: Regent Galleria, with boutiques including Chanel, Hermes and Louis Vuitton, is an elevator ride away from the lobby.
Mihan Honke offers three traditional cuisines: shabu-shabu, robatayaki and yakiniku.
The hotel has a heated rooftop pool.
Shilin Night Market is 5 kilometres (3 miles) from the hotel.

considerations.text: Transfers to and from Taiwan Taoyuan International Airport are arranged on request.
WhataHotel notes the hotel is in a busy urban area with city traffic.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the luxury positioning.

sources.title: Conde Nast Traveler: The Regent, Taipei
